_comment: SYNTHETIC values only (docs/CLAUDE.md). They keep realistic SHAPES so masking is exercised, but are chosen so they cannot belong to a real person: CIDs start with 000, phone numbers use the unassigned 9 prefix, emails use the RFC 2606 reserved .example TLD, and addresses are fictional. Never replace with real citizen data.
